meta.title: RFQ: raise by 10 (100 → 110)
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two existing bids without creating or searching for another event.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Enable RFQ price increases so the 100 to 110 revision should be accepted.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in Vendor A's portal.
Revise Vendor A's existing 100 bid by submitting the new price of 110.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the revised submission.
Return to the buyer's session to verify the revised bid.
Confirm both vendor responses remain visible as direct vendor bids.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison for both bidders.
Verify the two real vendor columns are present.
Verify Master QCS shows Vendor A's revised unit price as 110.
Verify the revised total reflects 10 requested units at the new rate of 110.
